_comment: Popular Dehradun businesses for the Townhall feed and agent recommendations. Researched 2026-11-01; every row cites its source. Several sources are aggregators: confirm a listing is still open before relying on it. coordsPrecision 'approximate' = locality/junction centre, not the shop door.

businesses.name: Kingdom of Momos
businesses.description: A casual, budget-friendly eatery in New Basti, Clement Town, known for momos and other fast food and described as a local favourite for momos in Clement Town.

businesses.name: The Old Monkeys Cafe & Restaurant
businesses.description: A cafe at CR Towers, Char Khamba Chowk, Clement Town (Subhash Nagar), with a hanging swing, artificial lawn and sofas, serving American, Italian, Mexican and Chinese food.

businesses.name: Kumar Sweet Shop
businesses.description: A sweet shop that has operated near Dehradun's Clock Tower since 1951.

businesses.name: Chetan Puri Wala
businesses.description: A long-running eatery near Hanuman Chowk in Paltan Bazaar that has fed locals for four decades.

businesses.name: English Book Depot
businesses.description: A well-known independent bookstore on Rajpur Road near the Clock Tower, stocked with English literary fiction, quality non-fiction and children's books.

businesses.name: Elloras
businesses.description: A Rajpur Road bakery started in 1953, known for its stick jaws (butter toffees), plum cakes and pista biscuits, and now run by the family's third generation.

businesses.name: Kalsang Friends Corner
businesses.description: A restaurant serving Indian, Chinese and Tibetan food, recommended for its momos, thukpa, garlic noodles, mutton shaptak and chicken shabalay.

businesses.name: Pacific Mall
businesses.description: A mall on Rajpur Road, Jakhan, covering more than 3.5 lakh sq ft, with over 100 brands, a food court, a kids' gaming zone and a 5-screen PVR multiplex.

businesses.name: Delhi Darbar
businesses.description: A casual, family-friendly restaurant on the highway at Majra serving mainly North Indian food, used as a stop by travellers and locals.

businesses.name: Dana Pani Multicuisine Restaurant
businesses.description: A restaurant on NH307 near ISBT serving veg and non-veg Chinese food for about Rs 500 for two, open 11:00 AM to 10:30 PM.
